data.one_liner: Dart package containing all Unicode emojis with utilities for searching, filtering, and manipulation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of Unicode emojis in Dart. Allows developers to look up emojis by name, character, keyword, group, or subgroup, as well as modify skin tones, stabilize, assemble, and disassemble multi-part emojis.
use_when: You need to access and display emojis programmatically in a Dart or Flutter application.
You need to search emojis by keywords, names, or categories.
You need to manipulate emoji skin tones or combine/disassemble emoji characters.
avoid_when: You need complex text-to-emoji parsing features like emojizing, demojizing, or replacing emojis in arbitrary text strings, as these features are not yet implemented.
You only need to display basic static strings and require no programmatic emoji utilities.
strengths: Up-to-date with the latest Unicode emoji standards.
Rich utility methods for filtering by keywords, groups, and categories.
Supports skin tone modification, assembly, and disassembly of complex emojis.
weaknesses: Text processing features like emojize, demojize, and replacing emojis in text are currently pending/not implemented.
Limited to emoji data and manipulation utilities.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the package to your pubspec.yaml and import it.
